name: foreach_sqrt_
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::_foreach_sqrt_(Tensor(a!)[] self) -> (). Applies sqrt independently to each tensor in self, mutates every list element in place, preserves each element's storage and stride, and returns no value. The correctness suite covers floating dtypes, contiguous and noncontiguous tensors, heterogeneous shapes, integer promotion or rejection, list semantics, and exact value/dtype/shape parity with ATen.
